payload.explicit_request: Review the checkpoint TASK_REPORT for task 'M2.1-CHECKPOINT-001'. Confirm whether M2.1 is approved for git commit and state transition in your RESPONSE_SCHEMA JSON block. task_report.summary: M2.1 checkpoint verified. 8 whitelisted artifacts created/modified across Slice 1 and Slice 2. All 16 unit and feature tests pass (146 assertions). Full application test suite passes (24 tests, 165 assertions). Zero regressions. User.php untouched. Ready for checkpoint commit.

tests.focused_feature: php artisan test --filter=R21MajorProjectControllerTest -> PASS (11 tests, 85 assertions)

payload.reason: The M2.1-CHECKPOINT-001 report provides sufficient evidence for checkpoint approval. The implementation is confined to the eight previously authorized artifacts, with zero unapproved changes and app/Models/User.php confirmed untouched. Both Slice 1 and Slice 2 focused suites pass, the full application suite passes with 24 tests and 165 assertions and no regressions, all eight files pass PHP syntax validation, and all 11 expected R21 Major Project routes are registered. The report also confirms that no destructive database operations were performed and that control-plane state files remain unchanged pending explicit authorization. Architecturally, the backend remains view-agnostic and therefore does not duplicate CampusLynk UI infrastructure; subsequent M2.2 workspace work must use x-layouts.workspace-layout and existing x-ui.* components, while M2.3 print work must use x-layouts.report-layout. The checkpoint evidence therefore satisfies the approved M2.1 scope and the required safety, testing, architectural, and design-system constraints. Git commit and persistent M2.1 state transition are authorized.
